Class HelpTopic

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.help.HelpTopic
public final class HelpTopic extends Object
One page of the help screen (/guide, and /coins when Coins is installed). Each mod adds its own, so players only see help for what the server has installed.

The text is asked for every time the page is shown, so it can include live numbers such as the player's balance or the jackpot. Each line is a translated message; one made with heading(String) is drawn as a heading. Up to two buttons can sit under the text, for example "Open my wallet".

      Parameters:
      id - a unique name, such as "slotmachine"
      order - where it goes in the list; lower comes first (Coins uses 0 to 50)
      iconItemId - the item whose icon is drawn beside the title
      lines - the text for a player, one message per line; see heading(String)
